summary: Exact candidate 7ba8f72eedf5db55b7b554cb2197cdbc454015ab is a verified partial fix. It adds a disabled-by-default framework step-reuse controller and corrects the independently reported tensor-ownership defect: in-place mutation by a scheduler or consumer no longer corrupts the canonical last real prediction or later reused values. It does not enable or validate a concrete stateful diffusion adapter and therefore does not fully resolve the original issue.

gpu_execution.evidence: Independent ownership regression passed on one AMD Instinct MI350X using Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015. This is not model-quality or multi-rank evidence.

remaining_counterexamples: No concrete model adapter is enabled, so request/modality/CFG scope switching, real observation semantics, thresholds, forced persistent writes, cache-off/on quality gates, full trajectories, and persistent session/KV equality are not validated on a stateful diffusion architecture.
Real multi-rank decision agreement and collective-control-flow safety remain unverified because only one GPU was assigned; the candidate has only a synthetic control/follower token test.

Model-specific _run_denoising_step implementations in Ideogram, LTX-2, JoyEcho, and progressive Ideogram bypass the shared controller hooks, so reuse would not apply to those paths without explicit integration.
remaining_limitations: No qualified stateful diffusion model weights or adapter were available; the deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot validate diffusion semantics, quality, or persistent world-model state.
Only one AMD Instinct MI350X was available, preventing real distributed validation.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Python and the prepared environment records native=null.
